intent: Make CommitGuard a repository-wide requirement for all branches, pull requests, ordinary development changes, and releases; clarify that required CI and branch-protection settings are needed because GitHub API commits bypass local hooks.
reviewed_by: Assistant diff review against the user's explicit repository-wide CommitGuard requirement; repository-owner review remains possible

requirements.text: CommitGuard policy must apply to all repository changes and commits, not only releases; CI and required branch checks must cover development branches and pull requests.

README.md.necessity: The README is the repository's authoritative developer policy; its prior wording did not explicitly establish repository-wide scope or distinguish CI/branch-protection enforcement from local hooks.
